element.name: Not Today
element.description:
In moments of catastrophe, you are fortified with the vitality of your future self.
When you are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. You then regain a number of hit points equal to twice your Warlock level and gain a bonus to AC and saving throws equal to your Charisma modifier until the end of this turn.
Once you use this feature, you can’t use it again until you finish a Long Rest.
